newsitem.title: USA: Delphi plans to begin regular stock div.
newsitem.headline: Delphi plans to begin regular stock div.

text.p: Delphi Financial Group Inc said Tuesday that its board had declared a two percent stock dividend and said it plans to begin a regular stock dividend program.
The company said the two percent stock dividend is payable June 10 to stockholders of record May 27 and that cash in lieu of fractional shares will be paid.
The company is the parent of Reliance Standard Life Insurance Co and Safety National Casualty Corp.
"We view this as another step in the continuing process of improving the market in our shares," it said in a statement.
